section_summary.extract_value: This section presents factor analysis results for the male sample using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). Parallel analysis indicated retention of two factors: General Body Appreciation (explaining 50.8% of variance, α=.90) and adaptive Body Image Investment (explaining 14.4% of variance, α=.68), which were moderately correlated (r=.34). The results are compared to findings from female participants, suggesting gender-specific factor structures.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents factor analysis results for the male sample of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). Parallel analysis indicated that two factors should be retained: Factor 1 (General Body Appreciation, explaining 50.8% of variance, α=.90) and Factor 2 (adaptive Body Image Investment, explaining 14.4% of variance, α=.68). The two factors were moderately correlated (r=.34). Table 1 displays the factor loadings for both women and men.
